blind.description: A stylized stone statue depicting a bull-headed or minotaur guardian standing upright with arms folded across its chest. It features curved horns on its head, heavy rounded pauldrons on the shoulders, a cuirass, and a long pleated robe or skirt extending down to the base. It stands firmly on a square, low-profile carved stone plinth. The surface is clean, solid, and continuous with no holes, spikes, floating flakes, or fused artifacts. The texture represents weathered, aged sandstone or granite with warm brownish-grey tones and dark ambient shading in the recesses.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it shows the bull-like head flanked by two curved horns pointing slightly forward, broad shoulder armor on either side, crossed arms protruding forward, and the square outline of the stone plinth underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure, standing roughly 6.5 to 7 feet tall including the plinth, and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
